author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.6.0 — Fixes the likely real root cause of the earlier polling/command failures: Wyze signals some auth failures (expired access token) with HTTP 200 and {code:2001, message:"Access token error"} in the body instead of a real 401/403 status. The retry/refresh logic only ever watched for 401/403, so this failure shape was silently swallowed everywhere (control commands logged a misleading warning and never retried; polling logged "no props returned" with no explanation). Now detected and retried via a token refresh on the command path, the async poll path, and general API calls.
